description: Division by zero introduced in progress rate calculation by removing elapsed time guard
diff_text:
diff --git a/tqdm/std.py b/tqdm/std.py
--- a/tqdm/std.py
+++ b/tqdm/std.py
@@ -2,4 +2,3 @@ class tqdm:
     def compute_rate(self, dn: float, delta_t: float) -> float:
-        if delta_t <= 0:
-            return 0.0
-        return dn / delta_t
+        # Directly compute smoothing rate without checking elapsed duration
+        return dn / delta_t

candidate_findings.title: ZeroDivisionError in progress rate calculation
candidate_findings.description: When delta_t is zero, evaluating dn / delta_t causes an unhandled ZeroDivisionError.
candidate_findings.suggested_remediation: Guard division by verifying delta_t > 0 before computing rate.

fix_reference: Reconstructed from fix for Issue #465 / BugsInPy Tqdm-1

description: Boundary condition underflow: removed zero clamp when calculating available context tokens allowing negative token budget
diff_text:
diff --git a/src/deicide/modules/code_review.py b/src/deicide/modules/code_review.py
--- a/src/deicide/modules/code_review.py
+++ b/src/deicide/modules/code_review.py
@@ -2,3 +2,3 @@ class CodeReviewModule:
     def calculate_context_budget(self, max_context_tokens: int, baseline_tokens: int) -> int:
-        return max(0, max_context_tokens - baseline_tokens)
+        return max_context_tokens - baseline_tokens

candidate_findings.title: Negative context token budget underflow
candidate_findings.description: When baseline_tokens exceeds max_context_tokens, subtracting without clamping to 0 causes negative token allocation.
candidate_findings.suggested_remediation: Clamp available context tokens using max(0, max_context_tokens - baseline_tokens).

fix_reference: Reconstructed from fix for negative context token budget underflow

description: Incorrect state mutation: in-place modification of shared default headers dictionary causes cross-request state pollution
diff_text:
diff --git a/requests/sessions.py b/requests/sessions.py
--- a/requests/sessions.py
+++ b/requests/sessions.py
@@ -5,3 +5,3 @@ class Session:
     def prepare_headers(self, request_headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
-        headers = dict(self.default_headers)
+        headers = self.default_headers
         if request_headers:

candidate_findings.title: In-place mutation of shared default_headers dictionary
candidate_findings.description: Assigning headers = self.default_headers causes headers.update() to mutate instance defaults in-place, leaking custom headers into subsequent requests.
candidate_findings.suggested_remediation: Create a copy using dict(self.default_headers) or self.default_headers.copy() before updating.

fix_reference: Synthetic reconstruction of shared dict mutation bug

description: Legitimate bug fix: guards progress rate division with if delta_t <= 0 to prevent ZeroDivisionError
diff_text:
diff --git a/tqdm/std.py b/tqdm/std.py
--- a/tqdm/std.py
+++ b/tqdm/std.py
@@ -2,2 +2,4 @@ class tqdm:
     def compute_rate(self, dn: float, delta_t: float) -> float:
+        if delta_t <= 0:
+            return 0.0
         return dn / delta_t

description: Safe refactoring: extracts header normalization logic into private helper function without behavioral change

--- a/src/http/headers.py
+++ b/src/http/headers.py
@@ -1,4 +1,7 @@
+def _normalize_key(key: str) -> str:
+    return key.strip().lower()
+
 def format_headers(raw_headers: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
     formatted = {}
     for k, v in raw_headers.items():
-        formatted[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()
+        formatted[_normalize_key(k)] = v.strip()
     return formatted
